static_traits.name: Chen Ming宇
static_traits.social_status: 与朋友的关系受影响，避免参与可能讨论园艺的Social gatherings；有少数朋友可交谈，但因害怕被评判而not yet分享与园艺相关的恐惧
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet出现类似心理问题；without既往心理治疗经历；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、配合度高，能具体描述trigger情境与感受；思维在雨天等trigger情境下易出现灾难化、个人化以及“应该”句式的自责

basic_info.main_problem: Excessive worry and guilt over the gardening hobby; persistently fears a rainstorm will destroy the garden, and blames themselves for it.
basic_info.core_demands: 当恐惧影响到日常作息与其他活动的享受时决定寻求咨询；希望在咨询中共同探索not同视角、挑战与重构灾难化信念，以减轻Anxiety与内疚，重新享受园艺。
growth_experiences: About six months ago, a storm caused some plants to wither; seeing the damaged plants initially triggered moderate stress, subsequently the mood intensified whenever it rained, and he gradually avoided gardening and frequently made catastrophic predictions; he tried self-comfort and seeking comfort from others but the fear persisted. This event became the key turning point for his later emotional and behavioral changes.

core_beliefs: 我not是一个称职的园艺者
坏结果It is all my fault
我是在失败这件事上without能为力的人

special_situations.event: 看到天气预报预测将有暴雨
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果我not能防止雨水伤害植物，就说明我not称职，坏结果都应由我负责
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: not停进行自我安慰、向朋友寻求安慰；提前回避与园艺相关的活动
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 花园会被毁，一切It is all my fault

special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 下雨等于植物会Death，这是对我失败的直接证明
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 停止园艺、减少外出以避免直面损失与失败感
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 所有植物都会死，这是我的错

special_situations.event: 在花园中看到受损或枯萎的植物
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 若植物出现损伤，意味着我not合格、我本该做得更好
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Repeated self-blame and rumination on the thought 'I should have done more', trying to force self-improvement with 'should' rules
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我not是好园丁；我应该做得更多来保护它们

special_situations.event: 准备参加或想到要参加可能讨论园艺的Social gatherings
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果do not人知道我的植物受损，他们就会评判我not称职
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoids socializing、回避谈及园艺以避免被评判
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 他们会觉得我not称职、会评判我

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be a competent caregiver who protects plants, recognized as a 'good gardener'
core_conflict.fear: 害怕失败与被评判；害怕因not可控的天气导致植物Death并被归责
defense_goal: Lowers exposure to being judged and failure feelings by avoiding gardening and related socializing
将责任内化为自责以获得一种可控的解释、暂时缓解Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: 内疚、担责的“not称职园艺者”
object_relations.object_representation: 他人（朋友/社群）是潜在的评判者与批评者

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor inquires about responsibility attribution for heavy rain and plant loss or discusses gardening failure
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 将咨询师的探询理解为对其not称职的隐性指责，并将外界“评判者”的形象带入咨询关系（移情）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use自责与内疚的措辞，强调“It is all my fault/我应该做得更多”，语气压低，减少为自己辩护。

manifestations: 避免参与可能谈论园艺的Social gatherings
因害怕被评判not yet向朋友分享恐惧
将not可控的天气结果视为个人必须承担的责任
频繁出现“我应该”自我要求与内疚
outcomes: 过度责任感导致自责与羞耻
行为回避与Reduced enjoyment of life

contact_model.definition: The individual takes in external rules and expectations without digesting them, treating them as their own standards or absolute truths, corresponding to 'rejection'.
manifestations: 频繁use“我应该…”来要求与责备自己
把not可控的天气后果视为自己必须负责的规则

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'.
manifestations: 担心被朋友评判而not分享恐惧
在社交中对园艺话题过度谨慎并回避

exception_events.target_problem: During weather forecasts or actual rain, the client usually catastrophically predicts that the plants will all be destroyed and blames herself, thus avoiding gardening.
exception_events.unique_outcome: 在某次暴风雨后，并非所有植物都Death；部分植物展现出较强的抗雨能力，来访者过往也曾在风暴中让多数植物存活。
exception_events.reason: 线索：记起“并非所有植物都会死”的事实与一些植物的韧性；此前的养护措施对部分植物有效，因此这次have not出现以往想象的“全部失败”。

positive_force: 具有在风暴中保持多数植物存活的园艺经验
愿意尝试not同视角并开展认知重构
拥有一定的社会支持（有少数朋友可交谈）
工作表现稳定（乐队演出not yet受影响）
negative_force: A thinking pattern of catastrophizing and predicting the future显著
个人化与“应该”句式导致过度自责
遇雨回避园艺与相关社交，维持问题循环
Sleep disturbed、兴趣下降（停止志愿服务）
依赖外部安慰但难以内化为稳定的自我支持

target_behavior.behavior: 雨天trigger的强烈Anxiety与内疚，并回避园艺
antecedent: 看到天气预报预测暴雨
在花园中看到受损植物
target_behavior.core_reason: 六个月前风暴导致植物受损的经历被Reinforcement；将not可控的天气后果灾难化并个人化为自己的过错
target_behavior.function: 逃避Anticipation的失败与羞耻，降低当下Anxiety强度
target_behavior.consequence: 停止园艺、Sleep disturbed、失去志愿服务兴趣、Interpersonal tension

target_behavior.behavior: 频繁寻求他人安慰与反复自我安慰
antecedent: 雨天或预报出现时Anxiety升高
想到植物可能在暴雨中受损
target_behavior.core_reason: 对外部验证的依赖与自我信任not足，试图通过安慰降低not确定感
target_behavior.consequence: Short-term relief but long-term maintenance of worry and avoidance; hard to form stable inner support

target_behavior.behavior: 避免涉及园艺话题的社交场合
antecedent: 朋友聚会可能讨论园艺
target_behavior.core_reason: Fears judgment and shame; mind-readingly assumes others hold negative views
target_behavior.function: 逃避潜在的羞耻与负面评价
target_behavior.consequence: 关系疏远、Loneliness感增加、社交满足感下降
